purpose: shared inputs for the acceptance vector; not scientific data

authoritative_semantics.authoritative_true: verified independently of the implementation under test; an implementation that does not reproduce it within the stated tolerance is wrong. Every fixture in this file carrying the flag has been re-derived by a party that did not write it.
authoritative_semantics.authoritative_false: computed once while writing this file from the rules pinned in the bundle. Implementations must still compare against it; a disagreement is resolved by re-deriving from the pinned rule, not by assuming this file is correct.

seed_primitive_examples.note: level-1 stage seeds; fill from the pinned primitive and verify

k1_identity_case.note: smoke budgets for the identity and D0 gates only; not B_history/tau

synthetic_primary_fixture.restricted_cost_rule: C = 1 + min(T, tau); capped -> C = 1 + tau; R = ln(C)
synthetic_primary_fixture.capped_precedence: capped_indices is authoritative. At a capped index the tabulated T value carries no information and the restricted cost is ln(1+tau) regardless; a null entry means the same thing. An implementation that computes min(T,tau) without consulting the flag is wrong.
synthetic_primary_fixture.paired_difference_rule: d_i = R_SEPARABLE,k6 - R_ALIASED,k6 (k1 arms are identical, so the difference-in-differences reduces to this)

case_practically_equivalent.note: constructed so the entire 90% CI lies inside [-ln1.20, +ln1.20] with no arm capped; these arrays replace T_aliased_k6/T_separable_k6 for this case only

case_unresolved.note: constructed so the 95% CI crosses zero, the 90% CI is not contained in the equivalence region, and no arm is capped; these arrays replace T_aliased_k6/T_separable_k6 for this case only

synthetic_shuffled_tag_fixture.note: N=20 k6 R-inputs for ALIASED / SHUFFLED / SEPARABLE; exercises the diagnostic contrasts of analysis plan section 14 and the diagnostic sign gate of section 14.1
synthetic_shuffled_tag_fixture.restricted_cost_rule: C = 1 + min(T, tau); capped -> C = 1 + tau; R = ln(C)
synthetic_shuffled_tag_fixture.capped_precedence: capped_indices is authoritative. At a capped index the tabulated T value carries no information and the restricted cost is ln(1+tau) regardless; a null entry means the same thing. An implementation that computes min(T,tau) without consulting the flag is wrong.

contrast_rules.interval: two-sided 97.5% paired Student-t CI on the mean
contrast_rules.sign_gate_trigger: cap fraction > 0.10 in any arm entering that contrast
contrast_rules.resolved_positive: 97.5% CI lower bound > 0 and, when the sign gate is triggered, SIGN_POS_PASS

labels.VARIABILITY_COMPONENT_SUPPORTED: V resolved positive, I not resolved positive
labels.STABLE_INFORMATIVE_CODE_REGIME_SUPPORTED: I resolved positive, V not resolved positive
labels.COMPONENT_DECOMPOSITION_UNRESOLVED: neither resolved positive, or any other pattern
labels.source: KILL_MATRIX_V0.2 and ANALYSIS_PLAN_V0.2 section 14.2; no other label string is permitted

case_diagnostic_heavy_cap.note: SHUFFLED is capped in 6/20 probes and enters both contrasts, so the sign gate is required for V and for I. V's 97.5% CI lower bound is positive but the Clopper-Pearson gate fails, so V is not resolved positive; the gate is load-bearing here.

negative_controls.note: digests produced by the two wrong index conventions, published so a mismatch identifies its own cause instead of appearing as an unexplained hash difference. An implementation reproducing one of these has an indexing bug, not a modelling bug.

locked_environment.note: all three implementations must build against these exact versions. NumPy decides the world-order and SHUFFLED_TAG permutations and the tau quantile; SciPy decides the Clopper-Pearson bound and the chi-squared factor in the N rule. A change to any of these is a change to the locked runtime (implementation contract section 17).

model_config_ref.note: ordered file set, not a single file; see implementation contract section 2
model_config_ref.root_rule: SHA256(UTF8("model-config-ref-v0.2\n" + concatenation over the four files in order of "<name> <sha256>\n"))

seed_primitive.digest: first 8 bytes of SHA256(UTF8(preimage)), unsigned little-endian, masked to 63 bits
seed_primitive.levels: stage namespace -> replicate_seed = seed64(stage, i); role seeds derive from replicate_seed, never from i

pair_split.rank_key: SHA256(UTF8("philosophia-alias-v0.2|pair-split|" + str(pair_split_seed) + "|" + str(a) + "|" + str(b))), full 32 bytes compared as bytes
pair_split.split_hash: SHA256(b"pair-split-v0.2|M=<M>|train|" + train pairs in lexicographic order as two uint16 little-endian each + b"|held|" + held-out pairs likewise)
pair_split.split_hash_property: set hash; independent of the ranked order

state_dict_hash.rule: SHA256 over name + "|" + tensor_hash concatenated in inherited parameter creation order

output_head.note: the '=' column is a trained but never-correct class, as at Level 0; narrowing W_U to 2M-1 is not authorized

shuffled_tag.extra_subset_rank_key: SHA256(UTF8("philosophia-alias-v0.2|shuffled-tag-extra|" + str(replicate_seed) + "|" + str(c))) for c in 1..6, full 32 bytes compared as bytes ascending, tie-broken by c ascending
shuffled_tag.extra_subset_selection: the first (P mod 6) codes of that ranking receive one extra presentation; the selected set is recorded in ascending code order. The ranking uses no pseudorandom generator and depends only on the replicate, so it is fixed for the entire replicate and identical in every history block
shuffled_tag.within_block_order: numpy.random.Generator(numpy.random.PCG64(seed64("shuffled-tag", replicate_seed, history_position))).permutation(multiset), where multiset is the length-P array of code indices in ascending code order
shuffled_tag.schedule_hash:
SHA256(b"shuffled-tag-schedule-v0.2|stage=|i=|P=

|" + for h = 1..6 in order: b"|h|" + that block's ordered code indices, one uint8 per presentation)
shuffled_tag.P_rule: under the inherited full-batch policy P = B_history * train_size exactly

context_scale_reference.rule: median L2 norm over the numeric rows W_E[0 : 2M-1] only, excluding the '=' row, taken once at model initialization
context_scale_reference.note: 2M-1 is odd at both authorized scales, so the median is an exact order statistic

model_config_acceptance_projection.note: byte-identity of v0.2_model_config.json across implementations is withdrawn as an acceptance item; it was never derivable from the bundle. The full config file stays free-form. Acceptance compares this canonical projection instead.
model_config_acceptance_projection.serialization: json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(",",":"), ensure_ascii=True) with no trailing newline, then SHA256 over the UTF-8 bytes

conventions.max_position: the number of input positions, equal to sequence_length; Level 0 has 3, v0.2 has 4, which is the '+1' of implementation contract section 9 rule 5
conventions.readout_position: zero-based index of the shifted '=' position
conventions.string_values: compared exactly as written here; no alternative spelling or casing is accepted
conventions.float_values: compared with the tolerance in comparison_tolerance

comparison_tolerance.rationale: summation order can move the last ulp of s_d and the CI bounds; a 1-ulp difference is not a divergence, a status or count difference is
